title: Edit Distance
summary: Count the fewest single-character edits that turn one word into another.
statement:
Return the minimum number of single-character edits needed to turn `source` into `target`.

The permitted edits are **insert**, **delete** and **replace**, each costing one.

### Constraints

- 0 ≤ source.length, target.length ≤ 500
- Lowercase English letters only
